newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria says not preparing for war with Israel.
newsitem.headline: Syria says not preparing for war with Israel.

text.p: Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara said on Tuesday Syria was not preparing for an attack on Israel and accused Israeli leaders of making the accusation to avoid making peace.
"Allegations...that Syria is escalating the situation and massing troops to launch a surprise attack are baseless," Shara said.

"Such allegations coming from the Israeli government are aimed at evading the peace process and the basis on which it was built," he told reporters at Damascus airport while seeing off his Russian counterpart Yevgeny Primakov.
In September Syria redeployed some 12,000 troops in Lebanon, moving some to within striking distance of a key Israeli position on the Golan Heights, spurring war jitters in Israel.
Israeli security sources said on Monday that Israel's defence chiefs have told Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu the army needed more than $1 billion because of an increased chance of war with syria.

Syria has held sporadic bilateral peace talks with Israel since 1991, but no negotiations were held since Netanyahu took over in Israel in June. Syria wants Israel to return the Golan Heights, captured in the 1967 Middle East war.
